ledger.title: Mather Pass north side question answered

detail.author: u/laurasaurus_hikes

extraction.quote_span: South side had a snow ramp with good steps

detail.quote: South side had a snow ramp with good steps
detail.text: For everyone asking, we did Mather SOBO on the 27th. The golden staircase is melted out. South side had a snow ramp with good steps, I used microspikes and my partner went without. It felt exposed near the top but fine if you take it slow. First long trail for both of us!

extraction.quote_span: It is a wall of snow with a bergschrund looking crack near the top

detail.quote: It is a wall of snow with a bergschrund looking crack near the top
detail.text: We got to the base of Mather 6/6 and looked at the south ramp for a long time and walked back to Palisade Lakes. It is a wall of snow with a bergschrund looking crack near the top. Someone said it goes fine with an axe but neither of us has used one before. Taking the bus around, no shame.
